text: DDABONG Tech Infographic (heritage insert, D-058/D-059): technical architectural cutaway visualization. Neutral dark base (charcoal to deep ink-navy, no sky, no texture), primary accent = glowing TAEGUK BLUE structure lines (RGB 0.20/0.58/1.00, #3394FF family) tracing silhouettes, creases and section edges; secondary accent = DDABONG brand red reserved for ONE highlighted element per insert (edit overlay, never generated). Slow push-in or a single short orbit, museum-exhibit pacing. Diagram may materialise into a photoreal cutaway while the blue structure lines remain as an overlay. Zero humans except a static 1.7 m scale silhouette in the plate. Zero in-frame text, labels or logos: all labels are edit overlays (English + one Hanja/Korean line, underline-style dimension marks). Structure comes only from the plate; the prompt describes materials and camera, never dimensions in metres (metre values are rendered as labels, verified 2026-09-19 V02/V03).
